name: Kibu
description: Content, compliance, and EHR platform built specifically for provider organizations serving people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). Helps DSPs deliver care while managing regulatory documentation across hundreds of orgs and ~48 US states. HIPAA-compliant; contact-sales pricing. Founded Jan 2022, US.

mentions.evidence: ~$234,319 MRR, 375 active subscriptions, ~$200,210 L30 snapshot, ~$3,096,047 all-time. Founded Jan 2022, US. Caveat: Stripe API key expired; revenue last synced Apr 19, 2026 (profile still shows cached L30/MRR snapshots). Last profile refresh cached around Oct 4, 2026 UTC.
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one regulated care vertical (I/DD, home health, behavioral health) in one country and own documentation + compliance + scheduling. Sell to ops directors, not founders on X.

whyItPrints: Pure regulated vertical ops software — the Conductor shape applied to disability services. Providers cannot improvise compliance; once the EHR + care logs live in Kibu, switching costs explode. High ACV B2B seats (375 subs → ~$234k MRR) without consumer virality.
